The best meal we had in Nha Trang!
Jan 2020
This restaurant was recommended by our hotel. Don't be put off by how it looks from outside, there are more seatings upstairs. Clean & bright. I would suggest you get someone local to translate the menu (photo included below) BEFORE you get to this restaurant because Google Translate comes up with hillarous translations! We had bún thịt nướng (rice noodles w grilled pork) and bánh ướt thịt (flat rice sheets w grilled pork). Came with complimentary vegetables, sweet chili-vinegar sauce and vietnamese tea. Nobody speaks english so be prepared! Everything was SO GOOD that we were tempted to come back again but we were leaving the next day.
By the way, this restaurant is walking distance to the DuCa Legend Theatre and there are lots of BBQ style roadside stalls on the way too. Smelt delicious!

Grill Pork perfections
Mar 2018 • Friends
When we arrived at this restaurant it was packed on the street level and I thought of looking for something else. The alert staff quickly lead me upstair where we found a spare seats on a communal table. There was a choice of about 6 Dishes which is essentially vermicelli noddles with Grill marinated chicken , Pork & beef. I took the pork which accounts for about 70% of the orders. When it came I ate it like it was my last meal, I did take a small amount of time to contemplate about the food and it dawned on me the whole place was quiet with just the click clack of chopsticks on bowls. Hungry diners devouring the amazing food in silence no need for conversation. The person who took me here has the exact type of restaurant and he still comes here to eat. If that's not an endorsement I don't know what is then.
